title: Gen-AI-TabDDPM_GReaT-Project
summary: A tabular generative-modeling research project (no README present) that compares approaches such as TabDDPM and GReaT for synthesizing tabular data. It vendors the sdv-dev CTGAN package in-tree (org-tab-ddpm/CTGAN, tab-ddpm/CTGAN) and its own script instantiates and runs CTGAN's TVAESynthesizer to train and sample synthetic data as one of the baseline generators.
needs: No README exists to confirm the project's overall scope or how the vendored CTGAN/TVAE baseline relates to the TabDDPM/GReaT comparison; title and use-case inferred from directory names only.
